hypothesis: Two equal visual-KV budgets may preserve different action-relevant information. This is a different attention-edge selection family, not evidence for the current layer-neighbor hypothesis.
mechanism: Compute both fresh images and the full dense VLM prefix, then gather retained per-layer K/V entries for action-expert attention. No VLM-prefill pruning or prefill-latency saving is claimed.
native_layout_findings: The decoder writes its51 tokens into the K/V buffer tail starting at encoder_seq_len.
Attention kernels take total key length from actual K/V tensor shapes, not just the prefix scalar.
K/V and attention scratch therefore need matching compact contiguous allocations; changing c.seq alone is invalid.
Native decoder RoPE uses original encoder_seq_len+arange51. Keep these absolute positions while moving packed storage; retained prefix K/V are already rotated.
Resize optional FP32 attention-logit scratch too; preserve and restore original runtime buffer ownership.
The inspected native softmax block supports at most1024 keys; the CPU plan rejects unsupported full-prefix lengths.

Verify exact camera/text index sets, storage contiguity, unchanged decoder RoPE and full buffer restoration after success/errors.
Validate actual NFE and context-token counts; keep original source and numeric tolerances.
